4 · Save the variograms

Saving pins the variograms of the chosen parameters at the chosen sample height for 04. It writes them to notebooks/variograms.json, which is committed with the notebooks, and the CPT samples of that height to data/simulation_samples_<height>cm.parquet. It leaves the other heights and the other parameters as they are; saving again at one height replaces that height's variograms of the chosen parameters. Each parameter has its transform, its sample height and, per domain, its model, nugget, length scales and trend, with the date it was saved and the date of the simulation domains it was fitted on.
